name: ADX System
summary: This EA uses the ADX indicator to identify trending market conditions and enters trades when DI+ crosses above ADX (for buys) or DI- crosses above ADX (for sells), requiring the ADX main line to be rising. It includes a trailing stop mechanism and fixed stop-loss/take-profit for position management.
summary_zh: 该EA使用ADX指标识别市场趋势，当DI+上穿ADX主线时做多，当DI-上穿ADX主线时做空，同时要求ADX主线呈上升趋势。包含追踪止损机制和固定止损/止盈进行仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ADX趋势强度指标与方向性指标DI+/DI-的交叉关系来判断入场时机。入场条件：做多要求ADX前值小于当前值（上升趋势）、DI+前值小于ADX前值且DI+当前值大于ADX当前值（DI+上穿ADX）；做空要求ADX上升且DI-上穿ADX。出场条件包括信号反转平仓（做多时ADX下降且DI+下穿ADX，做空时ADX下降且DI-下穿ADX）以及追踪止损和固定止损止盈。仓位管理采用固定手数，无动态仓位调整机制。资金管理仅检查自由保证金是否足够（1000*手数），缺乏更精细的风险控制。追踪止损在盈利超过设定点数后将止损跟进至盈亏平衡点附近，为持仓提供动态保护。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ADX trend strength indicator combined with directional indicators DI+/DI- crossover relationships to determine entry timing. Entry conditions for long: ADX previous value less than current value (rising trend), DI+ previous value below ADX previous value and DI+ current value above ADX current value (DI+ crossing above ADX). Entry conditions for short: ADX rising and DI- crossing above ADX. Exit conditions include signal reversal closing (for longs: ADX declining and DI+ crossing below ADX; for shorts: ADX declining and DI- crossing below ADX), trailing stop, and fixed stop-loss/take-profit. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management only checks whether free margin is sufficient (1000*lots), lacking more refined risk control. The trailing stop moves the stop-loss to near breakeven once profit exceeds the specified points, providing dynamic protection for open positions.

parameters.name: InpTakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数（3/5位小数自动乘10）

parameters.name: InpTrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数（3/5位小数自动乘10）

parameters.name: InpStopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数（3/5位小数自动乘10）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，使用ADX判断趋势强度配合DI方向指标，符合趋势跟踪的基本原理
包含追踪止损机制，能够在趋势延续时锁定利润并提供动态保护
具有固定止损止盈设置，每笔交易风险可预期
使用Magic Number区分本EA持仓，避免与其他EA冲突
支持3位和5位小数点自动调整，兼容不同经纪商报价精度
pros_en: Clear strategy logic using ADX for trend strength combined with DI directional indicators, consistent with trend following fundamentals
Includes trailing stop mechanism that locks in profits and provides dynamic protection during trend continuation
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings make per-trade risk predictable
Uses Magic Number to distinguish this EA's positions, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
Supports automatic adjustment for 3-digit and 5-digit brokers, ensuring compatibility across different quote precisions
cons: 入场条件要求DI上穿ADX而非DI交叉，信号触发频率可能较低且逻辑不够直观，传统做法是DI+/DI-交叉入场
固定手数无动态仓位调整，不考虑账户规模和波动率变化，风险暴露不均匀
资金管理仅简单检查自由保证金，缺乏最大回撤控制、每日亏损限制等高级风控
无新K线检查机制，每个tick都可能触发交易逻辑，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
追踪止损实现有缺陷：仅在盈利超过追踪止损距离时移动止损，未考虑步长（step），且平仓和追踪止损逻辑中多处使用return导致每次tick只能处理一个持仓
cons_en: Entry conditions require DI crossing above ADX rather than DI+/DI- crossover, which may produce fewer signals and is less intuitive than the conventional DI crossover approach
Fixed lot size with no dynamic position sizing ignores account size and volatility changes, leading to uneven risk exposure
Money management only performs a simple free margin check, lacking advanced risk controls like max drawdown limits or daily loss limits
No new bar check mechanism means trading logic can trigger on every tick, potentially opening multiple positions on the same candle

Trailing stop implementation has flaws: it only moves the stop when profit exceeds the trailing distance without considering a step value, and multiple return statements in the position management loop mean only one position is processed per tick
improvements: 改用DI+与DI-交叉作为入场信号，ADX主线作为趋势强度过滤器（如ADX>25才允许交易），更符合经典ADX策略
添加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线上重复触发信号；加入动态仓位计算基于ATR或账户风险百分比
优化持仓管理循环，移除多余return语句使每个tick能处理所有持仓；添加追踪止损步长参数
improvements_en: Use DI+/DI- crossover as entry signals with ADX main line as trend strength filter (e.g., only trade when ADX>25), aligning with classic ADX strategy
Add new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated signal triggers on the same candle; implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage
Optimize position management loop by removing unnecessary return statements so all positions can be processed per tick; add a trailing stop step parameter

risk_points: 无新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上多次触发交易信号导致过度交易
固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，小账户风险过大，大账户资金利用率不足
持仓管理循环中多处return导致每次tick只能处理一个持仓，多持仓场景下止损修改可能延迟
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause multiple trade signal triggers on the same candle, leading to overtrading
Fixed lot size ignores account size changes, creating excessive risk for small accounts and underutilization for large accounts
Multiple return statements in position management loop mean only one position is processed per tick, potentially delaying stop-loss modifications in multi-position scenarios
